subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Columbus Sails West
description: A quick win: understand Columbus Sails West.

hook.text: Columbus pitched sailing west to reach Asia. Every expert said the ocean was too wide. He went anyway.

buildup.text: Portugal, England, and France all rejected him. Spain's queen finally funded the voyage after years of lobbying.

discovery.text: Columbus underestimated Earth's size by 25 percent. He was wrong about the math but lucky about the land.

twist.text: He never knew he found a new continent. He died insisting he had reached Asia. His error reshaped the world.

climax.text: Columbus shows that wrong reasoning can lead to world-changing outcomes. Results do not validate the logic behind them.

punchline.text: Wrong math, right result. Luck is not the same as judgment.

quiz.question: What mistake did Columbus make?
options: He underestimated Earth's size but found land by luck
